stem_book: At 25 °C, which one of the following statements is not true? (a) The pH of 10⁻⁸ N HCl is 8. (b) 96500 coulomb of electricity is passed through a CuSO₄ solution to deposit 1 g equivalent of Cu at cathode. (c) The conjugate base of H₂PO₄⁻ is HPO₄²⁻ (d) pH + pOH = 14 for all aqueous solution
key: (a) the pH of 10⁻⁸ N HCl is 8 — the flagrant error ⚠
correct_answer: (a) The pH of 10⁻⁸ N HCl is 8
reason: Coordinator: 'At 25 C' added so only one option is true - not used. As printed (no temperature) (d) is also untrue (pH + pOH = pKw varies with T; same lecture's L6-Q10(c) tests exactly that), so '25 °C' put into stem_book to leave (a) as the single answer.
work: 10⁻⁸ M HCl: [H⁺] = 1.05×10⁻⁷ ⇒ pH 6.98, never 8 (a false); 1 F deposits 1 g-eq (b true); H₂PO₄⁻ − H⁺ = HPO₄²⁻ (c true); at 25 °C pKw = 14 (d true)
